mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (user_id, buy_at, total_amount, status, coupon_id) VALUES (#{userId}, CURRENT_DATE, #{totalAmount}, false, #{couponId})
INSERT INTO order_items (order_id, product_id, quantity) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{cart.productId}, #{cart.quantity})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM coupons WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM coupons_users WHERE user_id = #{userId})
SELECT id, user_id, buy_at, total_amount, status, coupon_id FROM orders WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY buy_at DESC

SELECT p.id AS product_id, p.name, p.price, p.category_id, p.area_id, p.image_path, oi.quantity
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
WHERE oi.order_id = #{orderId}
